passages.note: House Third Reading roll call on HB2492; Pingerelli voted Y on this single-subject voter-registration-citizenship bill.

passages.provision_quote: any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship as prescribed in section 16-166, subsection F, and the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
passages.note: Enacted text (Chapter 99) requires satisfactory evidence of citizenship to register and requires rejection of registrations lacking it, matching rung 5.
Lists Hoffman as prime sponsor and others as co-sponsors, not Pingerelli, and shows the Governor signed the bill as Chapter 99.

rows.reasoning: Pingerelli voted Aye on HB2492 (2022), a single-subject voter-registration-citizenship bill; its enacted text requires satisfactory evidence of citizenship to register and rejection of registrations lacking it, matching the rung text 'Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote.' The vote is within her House service.
